messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service 'inference-eu-prod' — INC-2026-0451. Symptom: sustained 5xx spike on /v1/generate, error rate ~18% over 2m. Auto-escalate: true. Details: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC12345 :rotating_light:
Jordan (oncall): I'm on it. Investigating initial blast radius. Assigning ownership.
Aisha: adding context — we just pushed model-quantization v3.2. Could be kernel mismatch. I'll look at recent deploys.
Jordan (oncall): Rolling back canary? current canary at 10% and 40m ago.
Ben: I can repro a 502 from the EU gateway, collecting logs. Attaching last 20 lines:
Ben: ```
2026-03-16T21:15:08Z inference-runtime ERROR handler.lua: kvcache get failed: timeout
2026-03-16T21:15:09Z proxy 502 upstream_reset by peer
```
Carlos: Autoscaler shows no unusual scale events. GPUs at 72%. No memory OOMs.
Aisha: Quick check — quantized kernels fallback path introduced a race in kvcache init. Pushing a hotfix branch now.
Jordan (oncall): If hotfix will take >10m flip to fallback model-variant (gpt-medium-fp16) to reduce error rate. Can we route?
Ben: I can apply traffic-split to 90% fallback now, will monitor. Doing:
Ben: ```sh
# route 90% -> gpt-medium-fp16
redwoodctl route split --service inference-eu-prod --from canary --to gpt-medium-fp16 --percent 90
```
Ben: Done. Error rate dropped to ~4% in 60s.
Sienna (support): Customer-facing update: major outages for EU customers. ETA for full fix?
Aisha: Hotfix build passes unit tests, pushing patch to canary now. If green, will promote in 8-12m.
Jordan (oncall): Good. Carlos, keep an eye on autoscaler and GPU metrics.
Carlos: Will do. No new errors in logs after traffic split.
incident-bot: Update: PagerDuty incident INC-2026-0451 status: acknowledged by Jordan (oncall). Notes: traffic-split applied, mitigation in progress.
Sienna (support): I posted interim update to customers: 'We are aware and mitigating; partial routing change reduced error rate. Will provide update in 15m.'
Ben: Rolling back quantization-canary to previous artifact as precaution.
Aisha: Confirmed rollback completed. Observability: error rate back to baseline 0.7% after 12m. Will follow up with root cause PR.
Jordan (oncall): Marking incident as 'monitoring'. I'll hand back to eng-oncall rotation at 23:00 UTC. Thanks everyone :heart:
Sienna (support): Closing customer loop. No data loss. Ticket updated to INC-2026-0451 with notes.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0451 status changed to 'monitoring' by Jordan (oncall). Incident will auto-close after 24h if stable. :white_check_mark:
